description:
Get the consent text to show a person before their enquiry (submit_enquiry) or viewing request
(request_viewing) about a listing is sent. It names the agency selling or letting the listing and
PropertyList, and says what is passed on. Show consent_text to the person, in full, and ask whether
they agree. Only when they clearly say yes, call submit_enquiry or request_viewing with consent: true.
Nothing is sent or stored by this tool.

language.description: The language the person writes in. The text comes in it where PropertyList speaks it, else in English.

name: get_enquiry_consent

agency.description: The agency the enquiry would go to.

consent_text.description: Show this to the person and ask whether they agree.

title: Get enquiry consent text
